details:
Project Details – Mars Outpost Commander

Mars Outpost Commander is an interactive Mars survival and science simulation game developed using PictoBlox for the NASA Space Apps Challenge. It allows players to experience the challenges of managing a human science outpost on Mars.

How does it work?

The player takes the role of a commander responsible for keeping the crew alive and completing scientific research over 30 Martian days (sols). Each sol allows only two actions, so players must make careful decisions. They need to manage four important resources: Power, Oxygen, Crew Morale, and Science Data. Solar flares, random events, communication delays with Earth, and crew isolation create additional challenges. Players must collect at least 100 Science Data and maintain the survival resources to win the mission.

Benefits and Intended Impact:

The project creates awareness about the challenges of human exploration on Mars. It helps players understand the importance of resource management, critical thinking, problem-solving, decision-making, and the psychological well-being of astronauts. It also makes space science more engaging and accessible to students.

Tools and Technologies Used:

  • PictoBlox and Scratch 3 programming environment.
  • Block-based coding with 835 programming blocks.
  • Sprites, costumes, backdrops, and interactive user interface elements.
  • NASA DONKI (Space Weather Database) for real solar flare information.
  • HTML, CSS, and JavaScript for the browser-based demonstration.
  • No additional hardware or extensions are required for the PictoBlox game.

Creativity and Innovation:

The creative aspect of this project is combining space science, survival simulation, and interactive gameplay. Instead of simply learning about Mars, players experience the difficulties of living there through realistic challenges and strategic choices. The project also includes a browser demo with movement and a robotic rover that helps players explore and collect science data.

Factors Considered During Development:

Our team considered the harsh Martian environment, limited resources, solar radiation, communication delays between Earth and Mars, crew isolation, life-support requirements, and the need for scientific research. We also focused on making the game interactive, educational, easy to understand, and suitable for young learners.

Overall, Mars Outpost Commander transforms the challenges of Mars exploration into an engaging learning experience and encourages the next generation to think about the future of human space exploration.
